thread:
Sofia: heads-up — Cascade Analytics enrolled 10 seats for the preview; telemetry shows only 2 active users this sprint. Renewal conversation in ~6 weeks. Need an activation sprint.
Ben: ack. Which teams are quiet?
Sofia: idle: product (3), data analysts (3), eng (2); active: 2 infra engs.
Tara: propose a 3-step 'activation sprint': 1) 1-question pulse to identify blockers, 2) 45m 'quick wins' workshop (split PM + hands-on), 3) offer a drop-in pairing slot for implementers.
Kai: +1. Also recommend shipping a tiny starter repo: /examples/cascade/quickstart with ingestion + retry logic. Engineers respond to code.
Sofia: risk: medium-high — if we don't bump to >=5 active users within 10 days post-workshop, escalate to AE for renewal prep.
Ben: I'll contact the buyer (Avery) with soft nudge and calendar options. Drop outreach copy?
Tara: Draft outreach:
```
Hi Avery — quick check-in. Noticed some teammates haven't had a chance to try the preview. Would a 45m "quick wins" workshop or a 1:1 pairing be helpful? If yes, pick a slot here: <cal.link/cascade-45m>
```
Kai: I've provisioned a short-lived sandbox: cascade-beta-sandbox (ttl 9d).
Sofia: Owners: Ben — buyer outreach + schedule (today). Tara — build workshop deck + starter repo (EOD). Kai — sandbox + starter repo PR. I'll monitor playbook and tag renewal risk if metric not met.
Ben: Buyer replied prefers Tue 4pm — can we run then?
Tara: I can do Tue 4pm. I'll craft hands-on exercises tied to their schema.
Sofia: post-workshop tracking template for playbook:
```
Outcome: attended / no-show / follow-up scheduled
Active seats after session: (n)
Top blockers surfaced: (list)
Agreed success metric: (e.g., 5 active users within 10 days)
Next action + owner + due date:
```
Kai: Starter repo PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/examples/cascade-quickstart. Sharing link in #cs-code.
Ben: Invites sent. I'll paste follow-up notes here after the workshop.
Sofia: If no lift, plan B = 2hr scoped pairing to land an ingest snippet. Escalate to AE. Thanks team :rocket:
